meals.ai_notes: **Glucose Goddess alignment:** This meal has good structure for blunting glucose spikes: fibre-rich fruit and greens are present in quantity; protein (eggs, salmon, cheese, yogurt) is prominent and savoury; healthy fats (croissant, avocado, cheese, salmon) accompany carbs. However, the dark jam (+10 g free sugars) and croissant (~28 g refined carbs with minimal fibre) are the highest glycemic-load items. **Recommendation:** eating the fruit and greens first, then protein & fat, then pastry/jam would maximise the blunting effect. Melon type affects precise nutrient profile. Total meal ~1.2 kcal, ~53 g carbs, ~22 g free sugars—moderate for breakfast if the jam is shared or mostly decorative.
